route.contextWindow_source: packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/defaults.ts DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW; models.ts catalog entry deepseek-flash

compaction-basic.formula: threshold = floor(min(W * thresholdRatio, W - O - headroomTokens)); retained = floor((W - O) * retainRatio)
compaction-basic.trigger: agent/pre-step before every request when token-meter pressure >= threshold; and on a provider-confirmed CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED (one maximal head reduction, then one retry)

command-compact.trigger: human /compact only; never in a headless run

tool-result-pruner.trigger: only when a compaction trigger qualifies (pressure or overflow), before range selection; model-free

spill-policy.trigger: at tool execution for results over 12,500 estimated tokens; read results pass through

token-meter: pressure = latest provider usage when it matches the measured envelope and is not below the estimate, else 4 chars/token heuristic over the whole envelope
